text:
aisha: Kicking off Paloma Health onboarding. Goal: production inference for triage assistant, low latency, and measurable cost targets. Can we confirm internal and customer stakeholders, top success criteria, and a proposed 30d timeline?
ben: Paloma contacts: Jordan (PM), Dr. Kline (CTO), Jenna (Security). I'll intro them in an email after this thread.
priya: From an enablement/SE perspective we need: model selection (open model vs. Redwood-hosted), dataset access for evals, SSO + audit logs requirements, and network topology (VPC or dedicated).
lars: I can own the initial integration run-through and sample infra. Propose week-of May 12 for hands-on session (1.5h). Who from Paloma will be on the call?
jordan-paloma: Jordan here — May 12 works for our eng lead (Sam) and security (Jenna). CT O is available May 14 if needed. Success criteria from our side: 1) inference in staging with representative load, 2) p50 latency <250ms, 3) cost estimate per 10k requests, 4) security sign-off on auditability.
aisha: Great — I'll map those to CS milestones. High-level 30d timeline: week 1: kickoff + security scoping, week 2: staging integration + evals, week 3: perf tuning + cost runs, week 4: rollout plan + go/no-go.
priya: Adding enrollment for enablement: enablement deck + demo app + hands-on tasks. I'll prepare a short checklist.
onboard-bot: New kickoff doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/paloma-kickoff (permissions: paloma@domain, redwood-cs).
maria-rev: Quick heads-up: renewal touchpoint sits at 11 months from now; if they adopt Redwood Dedicated within 90 days, we can offer preferred pricing. Flagging as opportunity to reduce churn risk.
lars: Risk log draft: - Security blockers (SSO/KMS) — owner: Jenna (Paloma). - Data residency/regulatory questions — owner: Jordan. - Model quality regression — owner: Priya (SE) with test sets.
priya: Example curl for quick smoke test (we'll provide token scopes in invite):
```
curl -X POST 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlhf-1", "input":"Summarize patient triage note"}'
```
aisha: Actions: 1) Ben to intro Paloma stakeholders (today). 2) Priya to share enablement checklist and sample eval set (2 business days). 3) Lars to schedule May 12 lab and May 14 security deep-dive (calendar invites). 4) Maria to prepare renewal incentive brief.
ben: Sending intros now. cc @jordan-paloma.
jordan-paloma: Thanks — looking forward to the checklist. Also can Paloma get a short runbook for incident triage and rollback steps?
lars: Yes, I'll attach a one-page runbook before the May 12 session.
priya: We'll capture feedback after each enablement session via this short form: https://forms.gle/example (1–2 mins). We'll add results to the kickoff doc weekly. :thumbsup:
aisha: Closing note: target go/no-go decision by end of week 4. If we hit security or model quality blockers, we'll escalate to enterprise ops and pause rollout. Tagging owners in the doc. :white_check_mark:
